## The problem

What you're trying to accomplish that OpenFirehouse doesn't support
well today.

If you're a firefighter, chief, or department admin: describe the
operational situation. "Our county dispatch uses X. We need Y to
happen when Z." Concrete department context shapes the solution more
than abstract feature names.

## What you'd like to see

Your best guess at how it should work. Mockups, screenshots from
other products, or just words are all fine.

## Alternatives you've considered

Workarounds you've used, or other ways to solve the same problem.

## Anything else

NFPA, NFIRS, OSHA, state-level requirements that bear on this?
Existing OpenFirehouse modules this would interact with?
